title: Political Ad Rates 2026: TV & CTV Costs by Market Size

facts.fact: AdImpact projects record political ad spending of $10.8 billion for the 2026 cycle, as cited by AdWave.
facts.quote: The 2026 cycle will see record political ad spending of $10.8 billion according to AdImpact projections.

facts.fact: AdWave's example states that reaching 100,000 viewers at a $25 CPM costs $2,500.
AdWave lists typical broadcast TV minimum commitments of $5,000-50,000+.
AdWave lists typical cable TV minimum commitments of $2,000-15,000+.
AdWave lists typical premium CTV minimum commitments of $10,000-50,000.
AdWave states self-serve CTV minimums can be as low as $50-100.
AdWave lists a major-market (Top 10 DMA) prime time 30-second broadcast spot at $15,000-75,000.
AdWave lists a mid-size market (DMAs 11-50) prime time 30-second spot at $2,000-10,000.
AdWave lists a small market (DMAs 51+) prime time 30-second spot at $200-2,000.
AdWave lists a small-market daytime 30-second spot at $25-150.
Per AdWave's summary of 47 U.S.C. 315, the lowest unit rate applies in the 45 days before a primary and the 60 days before a general or special election.
facts.quote: In the 45 days before a primary and the 60 days before a general or special election, a broadcast station or cable system can charge a legally qualified candidate no more than its lowest unit charge

facts.fact: AdWave states federal candidates must certify that any ad mentioning an opponent carries a disclosure shown together for at least 4 seconds at the end on TV.
facts.quote: shown together for at least 4 seconds at the end, saying the candidate approved the ad and their committee paid for it.

facts.fact: AdWave lists national news cable networks (CNN, Fox News, MSNBC) at a CPM of $20-40.
AdWave lists national sports cable networks at a CPM of $25-50.
AdWave lists national entertainment cable networks at a CPM of $10-25.
AdWave states zone targeting on local cable adds 10-25% to base rates.
facts.quote: Zone buying adds 10-25% to base rates but reduces waste for district-specific races.

facts.fact: AdWave lists Paramount+ at a CPM of $25-40.
